summary: All 13 bold KJV quotes (Isaiah 52:13-53:12 + Acts 8:35) are verbatim against passage.txt; Isaiah's first-person claims are correctly grounded (throne high and lifted up Isa 6:1, people in darkness Isa 9:2, unclean lips Isa 6:5, Ethiopian eunuch + Philip the evangelist Acts 8:27-35); substitutionary atonement sound, no supersession, lands on Christ with a grace-anchored CTA.
